app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: Ruled out: frontend-proxy Envoy missing/unhealthy upstream hosts. The immediate gRPC UNAVAILABLE (14) is NOT caused by Envoy having no configured/healthy upstream endpoints. Likely cause: a protocol/connection-level mismatch (e.g., Envoy attempting gRPC/HTTP2 to upstreams that aren’t speaking HTTP/2, or gRPC/TLS/ALPN negotiation failure) or client-side connection behavior — further investigation should target Envoy bootstrap/admin output (/clusters) and upstream service listeners and their protocol/port config.
